_about: Hand-written changelog lines per release tag. A tag listed here replaces the commit subjects on the website. 'Area: text' shows Area as a label. Releases with no lines anywhere are hidden.
_example: Voice: the interviewer's name follows its voice
v1.0.0: Voice: speech works without VoiceStudio. Supertonic 3 speaks and Parakeet listens, on your CPU. Settings > Voice downloads the models once (about 580 MB).
Voice: interviewers in a panel take turns with different voices.
Voice: smoother playback on slow CPUs.
Start: the first screen shows at once, then a short loader while the room gets ready.
Answers: type, listen only, or talk. Pick the mode per round.
Company rounds: research a company once. The loop then uses its real rounds and question bank.
Comprehension round: read a small multi-file project and explain your changes. Six projects are bundled.
Resume check: reads PDF, Word, RTF and text files the way an ATS parser does, then scores the match with a job post.
Feedback: send feedback from the app. Report a bug opens a filled-in GitHub issue.
Updates: Settings > Updates checks GitHub only when you press Check. Choose Stable or Experimental.
Storage: set how long rounds are kept, clear the log, and remove everything on uninstall.
Themes: Onsite, Nord, Rosé Pine and Gruvbox, each in light and dark.
